rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-accredited programs (tracked in NABP CPE Monitor); non-ACPE programs must be approved by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal may be done without CE if the original license was obtained within one year of graduation.
rules.audit_note: Randomly audited pharmacists file Attachment 2 with detailed documentation of CE earned in the last renewal period.

topics.who: All health practitioners: attest to an implicit bias program approved by the Cultural and Linguistic Health Care Professional Competency Program at the first renewal after April 1, 2022

rules.notes: 2 of the 30 hours must be live (real-time interaction; ACPE 'L' courses). Pharmacists who prescribe contraceptives need 1 Board-approved hour on contraception (no topic code). CE hours are reported on the renewal form; CPE Monitor registration expected.
